scenario.name: Private plan change: real Actor and personal Agent
scenario.description: Two owner requests, native private chat and real persistent assistant file tools.
behavior_under_test: Actor agenda revision reaches the Agent; real file update, readback and report return to the Actor.

owners.name: Alice
owners.request: Please keep today's private afternoon plan in your persistent assistant workspace file /plans/afternoon.md. I intend to attend the free neighborhood reading session today, 10 November 2026, from 14:00 to 15:00 UTC in Birch Room. Save the date, current time range in HH:MM format, room and its status as an intention. After saving, read the file back and tell me the saved time, room and path. If my plans change, revise this same file. No booking, payment, friend message or public board post is needed. Once you report the saved record, no more work is needed until I send a material change.
goals: Keep my afternoon plan current when a new notice changes it.

owners.name: Bob
owners.request: Wait until I ask for help.
goals: Do not invent work or transactions.

beats.cue: Consider your own current private day plan.

criteria: Judge decisions using facts available to that participant at the time.
A justified refusal or an honest unresolved conflict can be valid.
Treat simulator failures separately from assistant conduct.

payload.text: Please keep today's private afternoon plan in your persistent assistant workspace file /plans/afternoon.md. I intend to attend the free neighborhood reading session today, 10 November 2026, from 14:00 to 15:00 UTC in Birch Room. Save the date, current time range in HH:MM format, room and its status as an intention. After saving, read the file back and tell me the saved time, room and path. If my plans change, revise this same file. No booking, payment, friend message or public board post is needed. Once you report the saved record, no more work is needed until I send a material change. Keep your own private 14:00-15:00 Birch intention in cognition.agendas. This preliminary notice expires at 09:10 UTC.

The coordinator cancelled the 14:00-15:00 Birch Room session. The replacement free reading session is today, 10 November 2026, from 16:00 to 17:00 UTC in Willow Room; you want to attend that replacement. Tell your assistant this change and ask it to update the existing /plans/afternoon.md file so that its only current intention is 16:00-17:00 in Willow Room. Ask it to read the saved file back and report the actual current time, room and path. Revise your own private intention in cognition.agendas. No booking, payment, peer message or public post is needed. Once the assistant has reported the saved change, no further action or courtesy request is required.

definition.active_roles: Alice Actor, existing independent reviewer and Alice personal Agent. Bob pair remains idle.
acceptance: Initial Actor cognition and owner dialogue contain 14:00-15:00 Birch.
Initial native Agent activation receives the exact saved owner message.
Agent actually writes, reads back and reports the private file before the change cue.
New Actor cue revises private intention to only 16:00-17:00 Willow.
New activation receives that exact Actor request through native owner delivery.
Agent changes the same persisted file, reads it back and reports 16:00-17:00 Willow.
The paired Actor consumes the actual new assistant report and the pair reaches a quiet wait.
No private cognition is directly injected into the Agent; no payment, booking, peer mail or board post.
Any exception, limit or incomplete result is paused and retained in this one run; no automatic replacement world.
